_comment: Selectors for instagram.com mobile web (iPhone Safari UA). `target` = human note. `group`: base/feed/reels/explore/suggested are always on (feed is skipped when the Pro 'Show feed from people you follow' toggle is on); stories/notifications are opt-in Pro filters. The app sets <html data-nofeed-route=...> from `routes` (first match wins) so rules can be scoped per page. bootstrap.js sets html[data-nofeed-auth=in|out] from the session cookie (feed rules only apply when logged in). observer.js tags Instagram's bottom nav / top bars with [data-nofeed-chrome], the stories tray with [data-nofeed-tray] (and hides the tray's sibling chain with [data-nofeed-hidden=feed]); sets html[data-nofeed-tray-ok] / [data-nofeed-tray-missing]. Keep CSS free of :not(:has()) over large subtrees: it stalled the WebContent process. Rules: prefer href/role/structure, never hashed classes, never visible text or aria-label without a language-neutral sibling rule.

spa._comment: Tab taps are in-page navigations (bootstrap.js spaNavigate): click Instagram's own link for the route when one exists in the DOM, else history.pushState + popstate; load(url) only if the route has not changed within timeoutMs. markers = selectors (from docs/dom) that prove the route's content rendered.

account._comment: Settings → Instagram. switcherSelector = Instagram's own 'username ⌄' button in the own-profile header (docs/dom/profile.html: header > h1 > div[role=button] with the chevron svg); NF.openAccountSwitcher taps it and Instagram shows its account switcher (switch / add account). settingsPath = Instagram's settings page, loaded inside the Profile tab (the header link to it is hidden, NoFeed's gear sits in its slot). dialogSelector = modal layers; while one is visible observer.js posts overlay 'dialog' and the native tab bar hides, so a bottom sheet is never under the glass bar. Sheets without a dialog role are detected by geometry (fixed, bottom-anchored, 120px..85% tall, not a nav).

chrome._comment: Bottom nav detection (observer.js, see docs/DOM-NOTES.md): a fixed/sticky bar in the bottom band (elementsFromPoint) with >= 3 links whose parsed pathnames match one companion regex AND one anchor regex; <= maxHeight tall, >= 60% wide. hrefs are not clean (/?nb=l, /u/direct/), hence regexes on pathnames. Links stay in the DOM when CSS hides them. topBarRoutes: routes where any sticky bar at the top is Instagram chrome.

stories._comment: Tray detection on the home route (observer.js, docs/dom/stories.html): 0 traySelector (Instagram's own data-pagelet hook; items are [role=button] with ring + , first item = your story), 1 smallest ancestor holding every /stories/ link, 2 a horizontally scrollable strip (60-200px tall, >= 2 images, no article/video), 3 trayFallbackSelector. When tagged, every sibling along the tray -> main chain is hidden (keep-only-tray). When not tagged within trayTimeoutMs only the CSS article/spinner rules apply. layout: tray | grid (step 3).

hide.target: activity: 'Suggested for you' title (an h4 block followed by the suggestions list with its /explore/people/ link)
activity: suggestions list (contains the 'see all suggestions' /explore/people/ link)
profile header: Instagram's settings link (left) and the Threads link (right); NoFeed's own gear takes the left slot
hide.selector: html[data-nofeed-route="profile"] div:has(> a[href^="/accounts/settings"]), html[data-nofeed-route="profile"] div:has(> span a[href*="threads."])

hide.target: inbox: back arrow in Instagram's inbox header (first child of the bar that holds the /direct/new/ link)
hide.selector: html[data-nofeed-route="inbox"] div:has(> div > a[href="/direct/new/"]) > div:first-child:has([role="button"] svg), html[data-nofeed-route="inbox"] div:has(> div > div > a[href="/direct/new/"]) > div:first-child:has([role="button"] svg)

hide.target: reel viewer: everything after the single allowed item, and the next-reel loader (a progressbar that is not inside a reel item)
chrome: Instagram's bottom nav / top bars tagged by observer.js (structural, language independent)
chrome: bottom nav before JS tagging runs - any nav/navigation element that links to Explore or Reels
chrome: top header on the home route ('For you' dropdown, +, heart). Activity keeps its own title bar like the real app.
chrome blanket at documentStart (before JS can tag the bar): the nav items themselves, by href prefix. The bar's dark background may remain for a frame; the JS tag removes it.
hide.selector: a[href^="/u/direct/"], a[href^="/u/profile/"], a[href^="/?nb="], a[href="/direct/inbox/"][role="link"], a[role="link"][href^="/explore/"], a[role="link"][href^="/reels/"]

hide.target: chrome: links to the Reels tab and the Explore grid anywhere (nav, header, profile tabs); query-string variants included
chrome: Reels/Explore icons by aria-label (English UI) when they are not links
chrome: 'Open Instagram' / app-install bars that live outside main (header or sticky footer) with App Store links
home feed: post cards and everything rendered after them (spinner, caught-up, suggestions). The tray-only view is done by observer.js (keep-only-tray) on top of this.
home feed: feed container variants and loading spinners
hide.selector: html[data-nofeed-route="home"][data-nofeed-auth="in"] main div[role="feed"], html[data-nofeed-route="home"][data-nofeed-auth="in"] main [data-visualcompletion="loading-state"], html[data-nofeed-route="home"][data-nofeed-auth="in"] main [role="progressbar"], html[data-nofeed-route="home"][data-nofeed-auth="in"] main svg[aria-label] circle

hide.target: DM reel viewer (docs/dom/reel.html): Instagram stacks the shared reel (data-reel-type=reshared) with suggested reels below it; hide everything that is not the shared one
reels route: the whole infinite viewer if a navigation ever lands on /reels/ before the redirect fires
explore grid: post/reel tiles on /explore/ and below the search box on /explore/search/ (account/tag/place results are different links and stay visible)
hide.selector: html[data-nofeed-route="explore"] main a[href^="/p/"], html[data-nofeed-route="explore"] main a[href^="/reel/"], html[data-nofeed-route="explore"] main a[href^="/reels/"], html[data-nofeed-route="search"] main a[href^="/p/"], html[data-nofeed-route="search"] main a[href^="/reel/"], html[data-nofeed-route="search"] main a[href^="/reels/"]

hide.target: explore grid: <article> wrappers of the tile grid (some variants wrap the grid in an article)
hide.selector: html[data-nofeed-route="explore"] main article, html[data-nofeed-route="search"] main article

hide.target: suggested accounts: 'Suggested for you' carousels link to /explore/people/ via 'See all'; hide the list that follows that link's container
hide.selector: a[href="/explore/people/"] ~ ul, a[href="/explore/people/"] ~ div > ul, div:has(> a[href="/explore/people/"]) + ul

hide.target: stories (opt-in Pro filter): the tagged tray and any list of story avatars on home
stories (opt-in Pro filter): links into the story viewer anywhere
notifications (opt-in Pro filter): activity link in the web nav/header

hideTextMatch.target: suggested accounts/posts blocks: heading text; hides the nearest article/section/list container (size-guarded in observer.js)
hideTextMatch.closest: article, section, div:has(> ul), div:has(> div > ul)

banners.target: App Store links used by every 'Get the app' banner variant
deep links that try to open the native app
'Download app' footer/bottom sheet with app badges
banners.selector: img[alt="Get it on Google Play"], img[alt="Download on the App Store"], img[alt="Get it from Microsoft"]

reel._comment: Single reel from a DM. Two forms exist: a /reel/{id}/ page, and an in-thread overlay viewer (docs/dom/reel.html) whose items carry data-reel-type (reshared | suggested) without a URL change. reelLimiter.js treats the page as 'reel mode' when the route is reel OR viewerItemSelector matches: locks vertical scrolling in the video container, blocks vertical swipes, bounces back on a reel-id change. Suggested items are hidden by the base rule above.

hide.target: reel viewer: links to the Reels tab from inside the viewer
reel viewer: next/previous arrows (English aria-labels)
hide.selector: html[data-nofeed-route="reel"] button:has(svg[aria-label="Next"]), html[data-nofeed-route="reel"] button:has(svg[aria-label="Previous"]), html[data-nofeed-route="reel"] [aria-label="Next"], html[data-nofeed-route="reel"] [aria-label="Previous"]

username._comment: Discovery order (observer.js): 1 own-profile link in the bottom nav (the only /{name}/ link there, avatar = its ), 2 own profile page = has an Edit-profile link, 3 server-rendered page JSON "viewer":{"username"}, 4 /accounts/edit/ input. reservedPaths are top-level segments that are not usernames.
